title: 4 Hours Specialty Fishing Trip in Calabash
includes: All bait, tackle, rods, reels, ice, and fishing licenses are included
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Comfortable Clothing: Wear layers for changing temperatures
Non-Slip Shoes: Closed-toe shoes with good grip
Sun Protection: Sunscreen, hat, and polarized sunglasses
Rain Gear: Light jacket or windbreaker, just in case
Snacks & Water: Bring your own or purchase onboard
Small Cooler: For your catch or refreshments
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience a relaxed and exciting fishing adventure with Calabash Fishing Fleet on this 4‑hour Specialty Fishing Trip! Step aboard one of our spacious vessels—Miss Calabash (limited to just 15 anglers) —and enjoy the feel of an almost private charter without the private‑charter price tag.

With fewer lines in the water and plenty of space to move around, you’ll enjoy more fishing time, less tangling, and a smoother, more enjoyable experience for anglers of all ages and skill levels.
